changelog:
Initial release: Alibaba Cloud LHM tool for Hive-to-Paimon data migration (full and incremental).

- Supports both full ("存量") and incremental ("增量") Hive-to-DLF Paimon migration including DDL conversion, HDFS-to-OSS sync, and data load with row-count verification.
- Provides CLI tools for complete automation and standalone Hive DDL to Paimon DDL conversion.
- Includes features for dry-run previews, parallel/concurrent execution, direct-read optimizations, and detailed migration reporting.
- Emphasizes production safety: overwrites require explicit confirmation, credential security best practices are enforced, and dry-run/preview is strongly recommended before data changes.
- Scenario-detection logic guides users to appropriate scripts and options based on input type and environment.
summary: Hive 到阿里云 DLF Paimon 数据迁移工具，覆盖存量迁移与增量迁移全流程。存量迁移：Hive DDL 自动转换为 Paimon DDL 与 format-table 外表、rclone 同步 HDFS 到 OSS、Spark Thrift Server 执行 INSERT OVERWRITE，支持 orc/parquet/csv/json/text；提供 --auto-create-db、--force、--max-parallel 并行、--verify 行数校验、--direct-read 直读模式（OSS-HDFS/DLS 场景跳过 rclone）、迁移报告自动生成。增量迁移：三阶段流水线（DDL → rclone → INSERT）执行 hive-exploration 增量探查结果。内置独立 ddl_converter 支持 Hive DDL 快速转换为 DLF Paimon/FORMAT 外表 DDL。使用场景：用户提到"存量迁移"、"增量迁移"、"增量同步"、"Hive Paimon 迁移"、"Paimon 建表"、"Hive 数据湖迁移"、"format-table"、"direct-read"、"hive-to-paimon"、"migration-lhm-migrate-hive-to-paimon"、"转换 Hive DDL"、"建 DLF 表"、"生成 Paimon/外表 DDL"、"表记录数统计SQL"时调用此 skill。
